Overview of Valencian Community Region (Comunitat Valenciana)

Valencian Community Region (Comunitat Valenciana) is located in the Valencian Community region of Spain, with its prefectural capital at Valencia. Key sights and travel highlights across the prefecture include Valencia City of Arts and Sciences & Turia Gardens, Valencia Central Market & La Lonja de la Seda, Alicante Santa Bárbara Castle & Costa Blanca, Albufera Natural Park & Peñíscola.

RegionValencian Community
Capital cityValencia
Cities & municipalities83
Primary transport hubValencia Central Station (Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail)

How to get to Valencian Community Region

AVE / Ouigo / Iryo high-speed trains from Madrid to Valencia (1h50) and Alicante (2h15); Valencia (VLC) & Alicante (ALC) airports. Use our Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail Fare & Route Calculator and Rail Pass Value Helper to compare rail tickets and regional passes.

Signature local food in Valencian Community

When visiting cities across Valencian Community, look out for these regional specialties at station restaurants, markets, and local izakaya:

  • Authentic Paella Valenciana
  • Arroz a banda & Fideuà
  • Horchata de chufa with fartons
  • Turrón de Jijona
  • Valencian oranges

Best time to visit Valencian Community

Best time to visit Valencian Community: Mar–Jun, Sep–Nov.
